Great trendy spot! I was in town one day only but needed more than a cafe for calls. They don’t do day passes here but were so helpful and accommodating! Host Becky is amazing!!

a year ago

Jessica Mitchell

I had my wedding here and had a wonderful experience! Our wedding guests raved about what a cool venue we found. The space has a cool history that shows through its brick walls and chandeliers. We liked that it is centrally located in trendy Inglewood and still offers complimentary parking to guests. The Commons staff are true professionals, providing helpful advice for people like me who are not used to planning large-scale events. Shout out specifically to Caterine, Karla, and Nathan for making our day so memorable! The staff are true professionals who are great at what they do.

4 months ago

Matt

I had such a great experience at the Rail Yards location! They welcomed me with absolutely no hesitation and made me feel right at home. The team was so accommodating and even booked me a private room for the day without any issues. The space is clean, comfortable, and has such a positive vibe. Truly amazing service — I’m so grateful! Highly recommend this location to anyone needing a workspace.

a month ago

Yvonne Herring-Levins

Okay so I don’t even know where to start with how amazing this place is. From the clean social media friendly interior to the 2 floors of workplaces this place has everything you could want out of a coworking space. The coffee was fresh, the snack they provided were delicious and the bathrooms were stocked with things you didn’t even realize you needed. My adhd often has me struggling to keep focus in spaces such as coffee shops or libraries but at Work Nicer I got more done in a 2 hour work window than I usually get done in day! If you need your coworking space to be your home away from home than look no farther. Great location, Great Location and great staff!

Erin O'Meara Realtor

I've attended multiple functions in this room over the years and it's always clean, accommodating and well organized. The space is flexible and accessible for everyone.

5 months ago

Josh Methot

We used two of the locations during our time with Work Nicer. Great atmosphere, bright and open spaces, easy to use wifi, printing and delicious coffee. What more does an office need! Thanks team.

3 years ago

Julie Bekdashe

A bright and welcoming workspace! Plenty of room to work, and great coffee and tea selections! Highly recommend working from Work Nicer as you can get so much done and be around awesome people!

Nischay Behal (Nish)

The spaces, the events, the people, and the vibe in top notch. This is money invested. Both the spots - 17th and Rail Yards are fantastic ! Hands down the best coworking.

3 months ago

Andrea Kwasnicki

There are many places to choose from if you want to try co-working, but the vibe, community and the space at Work Nicer are second to none. I toured around and found all I needed at this space: closeness to the train, downtown address, friendly and professional community, helpful community curators, kitchen (beer tap and coffee are nice add-ons!), plenty of desks, and a few other cool features like bikes, ipad check in for visitors, and unlimited printing and board room access (within reason). Try it out. It's way nicer...!

8 years ago

Michelle Kang

Cool rustic vibes, was beautiful for our work event.

2 years ago

Thomas Graham

Day 1 at Work Nicer is the best day ever, until day 2, and 3...

Work Nicer is the place to be if you're looking for nice amenities and even nicer people. Staff and members here create a welcoming environment unparalleled in coworking spaces. I've fallen in love with what this place has to offer.

This place carries the best vibes 24/7 and doesn't get in your way when it's time to get the work done.

The location is fantastic, with easy access to, well, everything! If that's not enough, membership here also means membership at Work Nicer Rail Yards, which is a gem in itself.

I'd sell my left kidney to work here, but I don't have to! Work Nicer's pricing and access is so refreshing in today's landscape of upcharges and locked-away perks.

To be here is to experience belonging. The root beer on tap doesn't hurt either. Being limited to 5 stars feels like a disservice to the community.

Tim Auger

Great space at Roxbury: clean, comfortable, accommodating, spacious and you're surrounded by interesting, pleasant co-workers. What else could you need, coffee and beer? Well those are on hand too!

5 years ago

I've been with Work Nicer for over a year now and I highly recommend parking your day to day business in their hospitable hands. The spaces are clean and well presented for whatever your needs are, the inclusions are generous and the addition of fantastic onsite support is top notch. Shout out to Gorge at the Rail Yards, he is always popping in to say hello and ask if everything is ok. 5 Stars for cold beer, hot coffee, friendly staff, clean bathrooms and a stylish and fun spot to park my computer.

9 months ago

My Phuong Cadle

I went to a wedding here on the weekend and it was lovely, space is nice clean, fun place to party!

Rob Hole

Hands down the best co-share space in Calgary. Alex & the whole team at Work Nicer are awesome and very accommodating! I couldn't see our team working anywhere else. A+++

6 years ago

kevin trotter

I was in Calgary for work and unexpectedly got jammed up with a big project that required a quiet place to focus. I had no idea where to go, but a quick Google search led me to Work Nicer. I called to ask if they could accommodate me, and their fast response, warm welcome, and consideration for my needs instantly eased some of the stress. Great team—highly recommend!

Backstage Cosmetics

Work Nicer Railyards is such a fantastic place to work! The space itself is eclectic and full of character, creating an inspiring atmosphere that makes getting things done feel easy and enjoyable. Whether you need a quiet spot to focus or a collaborative area to brainstorm, there’s a perfect nook for every kind of work style.

What really sets Work Nicer apart, though, is the incredible community. The people here are welcoming, supportive, and genuinely invested in helping each other succeed. It’s more than just a coworking space—it’s a place where connections are made, ideas flow, and work feels more rewarding. If you’re looking for a space that’s both vibrant and productive, Work Nicer Railyards is the place to be!

11 months ago

Jason Bekdashe

My experience at Work Nicer Red Mile (and Beaverhouse in Edmonton) has been nothing short of awesome. Great spaces to work in, everything you could need in a cowork environment, and a wonderful community. The folks that run this space are in it for the right reasons. Highly recommend Work Nicer if you’re looking for a good, supportive and welcoming cowork community.

Karen Murdock

Great ambiance foe everything from a wedding to a business launch.

Yasmin Hovakeemian

Great co-working space. However I noticed it was a bit messy when I came in one afternoon. Post lunch crumbs and empty bottles on shared tables. Could use a clean up. Otherwise nice spaces.

7 years ago

J Chisholm

I’ve been a member at Work Nicer in Calgary since 2022, and it’s hard to overstate how much they’ve helped my business grow. The networking opportunities alone are worth the membership. I’ve met collaborators, clients, and friends just by showing up, grabbing a coffee, and plugging in. There’s always someone interesting to talk to, and the community has a “we’re all building something” vibe that keeps you motivated.

Amenities are over the top in the best way: open coffee bar, kombucha and Annex Root Beer on tap, strong Wi-Fi, tons of meeting spaces, phone booths, and all the little details that make long days actually enjoyable instead of draining. The decor and overall vibe are on another level. It feels modern and energetic without being pretentious, and every location I’ve used has been consistently clean, comfortable, and well thought out for people who actually work there, not just visit for an hour.

What really sets Work Nicer apart, though, is the team. Alex, Sean, Becky, Everett, and George have all gone out of their way to support me and my business, whether that’s making introductions, helping with events, or just checking in. Their dedication to the members is obvious, and it shows in the culture they’ve built.

If you’re a freelancer, small business owner, or growing company in Calgary and you’re on the fence about coworking, I’d strongly recommend giving Work Nicer a shot. Joining was one of the best decisions I’ve made for my business.

a week ago

James Reckseidler

Work Nicer Rail Yards is an exceptional space for meetings and productivity! If you are in need of a quiet space to meet with collaborators or clients, or just an inspirational space to get your ideas together, this space can't be beat!

Kyra Yeske

I had my wedding here this past October and it was absolutely perfect! The building fit the aesthetic of the wedding perfectly (theme was “Til death do us part”) and the staff were wonderful and extremely skilled at coordinating everything. They were even able to accommodate our unconventional timeline of having my first look with my parents before the ceremony in the Parlour Room while my husband took his family photos simultaneously in the Hemingway Room. We opted to have the ceremony and reception both in the Hemingway Room and the staff were able to perfectly execute my vision for both events and flipped the room in a timely manner. After everything was done, the staff packed everything away neatly into boxes and came in special the next morning to open the venue so my parents could pick up the decor. They went above and beyond to make everything absolutely perfect!

in the last week

Lilit Houlder

What a beautiful interior, nicely decorated space. Most importantly, the open space areas are nice and quiet, not a shortage of desks, private pods, or meeting rooms.

My favourite thing (outside of the kitchen/lounge area) is how technologically advanced it is, with tablets indicating booking times for each meeting room, and a super easy laptop to TV screen projection system.

Oh, and the cute little table fans are a nice touch.

Would 10/10 recommend this due to location and all the office conveniences the Work Nicer office comes with.

Barbara Rahal

Work Nicer is like home away from home, they are not only on a great location downtown, but also they host you in a beautiful renovated historic building, multi office open space with many different rooms if you prefer to stay private, board rooms and charming common areas.

Welcoming staff and MORE than accommodating. Everyone is incredibly helpful and friendly.

Something really worth notice is that during this uncertain times where we all are skeptic about leaving home and our safety, they ensure cleanliness within the space, there are multiple sanitizing stations and always prioritize a helping hand.

Whether you're someone who prefers to work alone in privacy, or someone who wants to be around highly-driven individuals.Work Nicer is definitely the place for you.

There are so many perks of being a part of this growing community, but my favourite is that the best food is within walking distance and they offer awesome coffee and craft beers with your membership ( and so much more, bike sharing etc)

Work Nicer seriously focus on building a strong and awesome community, you will arrive to a place with a bunch of amazing people and all type of creatives and focused entrepreneurs. This is for sure a place where you can be super productive but also have fun while at it.

4 years ago

Mawahib Ali

My husband and I came here for our annual meeting. Really nice space, clean well put together, and it has something for EVERYONE!!

Staff is super polite and nice.

Great Tea and Coffee options as well.

Will definitely come back here.

Adam Fyfe

Awesome workspace, a bit dark, but that's the vibe there. If your in need of space, i would strongly recommend it.

2 weeks ago

Leigh M.

Beautiful space, quiet, plenty of room to work, easy to book meeting rooms. This is one of the best cooking spaces I’ve been to. Highly recommend if you’re considering. I’m glad I joined, and the staff are helpful with getting me setup quickly.

Michael Robinson

Very great place to work. Hannah was welcoming, friendly and made me feel right at home. Work Nicer is a friendly community with great facilities - plenty of space to setup for the day and private spaces to take meetings.

Located right down town, Work Nicer has lots of nice little touches that differentiate it - whether it be the Happy Hour Thursday or breakfast treats for example. Highly recommend Work Nicer as a place to work and very much enjoyed my time.

Rinaldi396

The guys at Work Nicer Railyards is exactly what you need when you’re in town and need a functional, membership-based coworking space that actually works the way it’s supposed to. they went over and above to take care of me. thier Membership gives you flexible access to hot desks, dedicated desks, private offices, meeting spaces, and community areas with no leases or lock-ins — you just show up, plug in, and get to work. Unlimited access and included meeting room time make short-notice use painless.

The Wi-Fi and tech infrastructure are solid — strong, reliable internet and printing/scanning are available without hiccups. Staff were very accommodating on very short notice and got me set up quickly. Everything from the workspace itself to the support tech works smoothly. I couldn’t be happier with the experience and highly recommend them for anyone needing a professional, hassle-free place to work.

Two Outposts. One community.

Explore

Tour the Outpost

Nestled right on 17th Ave and 5th St SW, the Red Mile outpost puts your team in the heart of Calgary’s Beltline & Mission neighbourhoods. Floor-to-ceiling windows, open work areas, high-top stations and focus zones cater to teams of all sizes - from independent contributors to growing enterprises. With 24/7 smart access, rapid internet, and a location that keeps you plugged into the city’s pulse, Red Mile supports productivity, connection and presence.

Located near Calgary’s Inglewood & Ramsay neighbourhoods, the Rail Yards outpost is designed for the next-level team. With large event spaces, room to scale, and a vibrant community around you, Rail Yards offers the backdrop for enterprise ambition and entrepreneurial energy alike. Whether you’re hosting a client pitch, organizing a workshop, or simply collaborating with your peers, you’ll find the space and the network to make it happen.
